checks.name: Fresh document identity remains distinct from the saved logical reward run in native and Android calls
Live purchase sends one stable transaction, prevents concurrent sends and awaits durable journal confirmation
Timeout keeps the same reserved transaction pending and never manufactures clean-rejection refund proof
Pending retry reconciles committed journal entries first and resends only the original uncommitted ID
Native clean rejection is forwarded unchanged; stale logical requests and saving/busy state cannot buy
Pending startup transactions keep readiness closed until native and phone reconciliation complete
Actual saved-game helper hydrates all native files before persistence dependency release and verifies resumed logical run before readiness
Unhydrated saves and failed resumed-state persistence keep both startup readiness gates closed
Actual saved-game busy getter blocks a live purchase while its save operation is draining input
A genuinely unresolved native purchase releases UI busy at the bounded acknowledgement deadline without refund proof
A late native committed journal settles the original reservation after the acknowledgement deadline
Retry after an unresolved acknowledgement reuses the original business transaction and releases busy after verified proof
An outgoing document ignores a native journal arriving after the purchase deadline
Tiny +5 notice stays inside the Rewards header, reuses one small node and preserves its main span caption
Exit inventories use the logical native session while phone callbacks remain document-bound; outgoing purchase results are ignored
Dormant Duel loads no rewards, saved-game wrapper or pollers
